_readme: Default inputs per building type for the peak-load tool. Every value carries a source. Values with "verify": true were transcribed from the cited standard or carried over from the Total Carbon Tool energy module and must be confirmed by the MEP lead before results are relied upon. All of them are editable in the UI and in scenario JSON.

activity_w_per_person.source: DOE/PNNL commercial prototype models activity schedule; consistent with ASHRAE Fundamentals Ch.18 Table 1 office-work range

perimeter_depth_m.source: DOE/PNNL commercial prototype models (15 ft perimeter zones)

floor_to_floor_m.source: DOE/PNNL medium office prototype floor-to-floor (13 ft)

wwr.source: ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G baseline maximum window-to-wall ratio (40%)

slab_f_factor_w_mk.source: ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix A, unheated uninsulated slab-on-grade F-0.73 Btu/h-ft-F

cooling_supply_air_c.source: Common VAV cooling design supply air temperature (55 F) - choose per system type

heating_supply_air_c.source: Typical VAV reheat discharge temperature (95 F) - choose per system type

infiltration_ach.source: Carried over from the Total Carbon Tool energy module (js/energy-model.js) (UA_inf assumption); not from a standard

unoccupied_internal_fraction.unit: fraction of design lighting/equipment outside occupied hours
unoccupied_internal_fraction.source: Assumption: zero. Conservative for heating; slightly low for cooling pull-down

cooling_sizing_factor.source: No safety factor applied by default. ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G uses 1.15 cooling / 1.25 heating for the baseline only

heating_sizing_factor.source: No safety factor applied by default (see cooling_sizing_factor)

envelope_by_climate_zone._source: Carried over from the Total Carbon Tool energy module (js/energy-model.js) ENV_DEFAULTS (labelled ASHRAE 90.1-2019 there; not re-verified against Tables 5.5-1..8). Units W/m2-K for U, SHGC dimensionless.

oa_per_area_ls_m2.source: ASHRAE 62.1-2019 Table 6-1, Office space Ra = 0.06 cfm/ft2

m2_per_person.source: ASHRAE 62.1-2019 Table 6-1 default occupant density 5 /1000 ft2
